data.text: DUNGEON B3F: TEN MIXED TRIALS
BACK TO B2F
SHOP: PUSH TO BUY
KEYS ARE HIDDEN IN THE TRIALS. THE VAULT IS EAST
B4F: THE CLOCKWORK
SLIDE INTO THE SWITCH. BLUE AND RED STOP YOU IN TURN
THE GAP SLIDES DOWN ONE STEP PER PUSH
ONLY A BOULDER CAN HOLD THE PLATE. LEAVE THE ROOM TO RESET IT
THREE BUTTONS, NO NUMBERS. THE SIGNS ALONG THE WALLS TELL THE ORDER
NOT EVERY BUTTON BELONGS
FIRST: THE ONE THAT FACES THE POND
SECOND: THE ONE UNDER THE LANTERN
THIRD: THE ONE THE CRATES HIDE
CATCH A FISH: FACE THE WATER, PRESS SPACE
PUSH THE CLOCK AND WALK. NO JUMPING, NO SPRINGS
SHORTCUT (THE FISH WON'T LIKE IT)
BRING ME A FISH
THE PATROL FLIPS THE SWITCH EVERY LAP. A TREE IN THE LANE STOPS IT
THE BOULDER PASSES ONLY WHILE BOTH BLUE WALLS SLEEP
LEAVE AND RETURN TO RESET
FIVE LIGHTS. EACH SWITCH FLIPS ITSELF AND ITS NEIGHBORS
LOWER ALL FIVE BLOCKS
TWO CLOCKS IN A CHAIN. EACH SHUTTER IS FAR FROM ITS CLOCK
THE SECOND CLOCK
BRIDGE THE WATER, THEN SEND A BOULDER ACROSS. EAST ONE FIRST
THE RED WALL RISES BEHIND WHOEVER PRESSES THE SWITCH. THE KEY IS SOUTH
THE HIGHWAY: PATROLS KNOCK YOU BACK. CROSS BETWEEN THEM
TWO KEYS ON THIS FLOOR, THREE DOORS. CHOOSE
LEFT: A PILE OF COINS
MIDDLE: THE GRAND PRIZE
RIGHT: SUPPLIES
